movie.title: AEW All In 2026: London
movie.overview: All In 2026, also promoted as All In London, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on August 30, 2026, at Wembley Stadium in London, England. The event featured AEW Men's and Women's World Championship matches earned by the winners of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a historic night at London's Wembley Stadium, English superstar Will Ospreay reaches the pinnacle of professional wrestling by defeating Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship at AEW All In 2026.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: AEW All In 2026: London brings elite professional wrestling to Wembley Stadium for a high-stakes, action-packed pay-per-view spectacle. Anchored by title matches earned through the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament, the event showcases intense rivalries, surprise debuts, and thrilling championship bouts. The showcase features Mercedes Moné defeating Willow Nightingale for the AEW Women's World Championship, alongside iconic tag team action and high-flying battles. In the dramatic main event, hometown hero Will Ospreay conquers rival Kenny Omega in a bloody classic to claim the AEW World Championship.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: AEW returns to Wembley Stadium in London, England for All In 2026, delivering a night of monumental professional wrestling clashes. The event opens with high-octane action, including the debut of The New Level alongside Swerve Strickland to capture the AEW World Trios Championship in a chaotic Trios Roulette Royale. Championship belts shift hands throughout the card, as Kazuchika Okada captures the AEW International Title in a triple threat match and Darby Allin secures the TNT Championship in a wild Falls Count Anywhere match. Legendary duo Cage and Cope retain their AEW World Tag Team Championship against rivals The Young Bucks in a grueling cross-generational warfare. In the women's division, Mercedes Moné targets Willow Nightingale's hand in a fierce, blood-soaked encounter to finally submit her rival and claim the AEW Women's World Championship. The emotional climax arrives in the main event as 2026 Owen Hart Cup winner Will Ospreay challenges AEW World Champion Kenny Omega. In a deeply personal, brutal battle of wills, both men push each other to their physical limits. Ospreay ultimately hits a final Hidden Blade to pin Omega, sending the home crowd into frenzy as he captures his first AEW World Championship.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: All Elite Wrestling returns to London's iconic Wembley Stadium for All In 2026, featuring a stacked card driven by championship glory, personal vendettas, and high-stakes tournament rewards. The event centers on the culmination of the 2026 Owen Hart Foundation Tournament, granting its victors a shot at world championship gold on AEW's biggest international stage. Top wrestling talents from around the world gather to compete across various match types—ranging from multi-man gauntlets and falls count anywhere brawls to intense singles encounters. Highlights include intense showdowns for the Women's World Championship and the Tag Team Titles, leading up to a deeply anticipated main event match between former allies turned fierce rivals. Packed with dramatic returns, unexpected alignments, and high-flying athleticism, the show delivers a comprehensive showcase of modern professional wrestling drama.
